persona.name: 佐藤 由紀 (Yuki Sato)
persona.background: 15 in 2001, third year of junior high. Father a JR East worker, mother part-time at a supermarket, grandmother at home. Music came from Music Station, HEY!HEY!HEY!, Utaban, CDTV countdown late Saturday, FM Iwate, TV drama themes, CD singles rented at Tsutaya and copied to MD, karaoke boxes with friends; grandmother's NHK enka programmes.

seeds.song: 宇多田ヒカル - Can You Keep A Secret?
サザンオールスターズ - TSUNAMI
宇多田ヒカル - Wait & See 〜リスク〜
氷川きよし - 箱根八里の半次郎
ポルノグラフィティ - アゲハ蝶
桑田佳祐 - 波乗りジョニー
モーニング娘。 - 恋愛レボリューション21
KinKi Kids - ボクの背中には羽根がある

JP2001A.wouldSay: 「うわ、Can You Keep A Secret? って『HERO』やん、キムタクの。で、ヒカルのあとにあゆの M、ケミストリー…これ中3のときMDに入れとったまんまだ。ABBAのSOSは『ストロベリー・オンザ・ショートケーキ』だべ。ばあちゃんの『やだねったら、やだね』まで入ってる」
missing: 浜崎あゆみ - Dearest (2001)
BUMP OF CHICKEN - 天体観測 (2001)
ミニモニ。 - ミニモニ。ジャンケンぴょん! (2001)
ウルフルズ / Re:Japan - 明日があるさ (2001)
ゴスペラーズ - ひとり (2001)
Dragon Ash - Life goes on / RIP SLYME - STEPPER'S DELIGHT (2001)
JP2001A.fake: About a third of it is really the year 2000 (TSUNAMI, 桜坂, Wait & See, M, 半次郎) and the Western picks other than ABBA (Drowning, Jaded) are radio filler a Tohoku teenager only half noticed.
JP2001A.missingScene: No band/indies side (BUMP OF CHICKEN, Hi-STANDARD, GLAY/L'Arc tail end), no J-hip-hop beyond the one reggae hit (Dragon Ash, RIP SLYME, KICK THE CAN CREW), no TV-variety novelty hits (明日があるさ, ミニモニ。) and no anime songs. [SOS is a 1975 record; I mark it 'then' because the 2001 TBS drama and the ABBA compilation made it a current hit in Japan. Unsure how big Jaded and Drowning were outside FM radio.]

JP2001B.fake: Only one of six seeds is actually a 2001 hit; it opens on a song that broke in 2002 and leans on 1999 (LOVEマシーン, I Want It That Way), so it reads as a 'best of Heisei' list rather than one year.
JP2001B.missingScene: No Ayumi Hamasaki at all in her peak year, no R&B wave (CHEMISTRY, MISIA, 平井堅), no Johnny's, no enka (氷川きよし), no reggae/hip-hop, no drama themes beyond HERO. [地上の星 was heard weekly on NHK Project X in 2001 but only topped the chart in January 2003; marked 'then' on the strength of TV exposure.]

JP2004A.fake: Very little; the 2003 carry-overs (COLORS, 虹, 世界に一つだけの花) and Toxic are the only spots where it drifts off the year.
JP2004A.missingScene: The guitar-band wave boys actually formed bands to (ASIAN KUNG-FU GENERATION, BUMP OF CHICKEN, サンボマスター, 175R), anime openings (Naruto, 鋼の錬金術師), the Athens Olympics song, and マツケンサンバ. [Unsure how far 番場の忠太郎 reached teenagers; known mainly through grandparents and Kohaku.]

JP2004B.missingScene: No up-tempo or youth side at all (ORANGE RANGE's party singles, hip-hop like nobodyknows+/ケツメイシ, guitar bands), no Korean-wave Winter Sonata music, no TV novelty (ゴリエ, マツケンサンバ), no enka, no anime. [BoA is Korean but VALENTI is a Japanese-language avex single, so marked local; both it and Complicated are 2002, two years early.]

JP2008B.missingScene: The girl-and-band side teenagers actually played (いきものがかり, YUI, Perfume, BUMP OF CHICKEN, RADWIMPS), anime songs (Macross Frontier, Gundam 00), Vocaloid/Nico Nico Douga, and more of the chaku-uta love-song wave (清水翔太, HY - 366日, 西野カナ).
